one_sentence_story: After a head injury cut the wire between his face-recognition patch and his brain's emotional alarm, a young man looked straight at his own mother and swore she was an identical impostor — yet recognized her instantly on the telephone.
so_what_for_you: Recognizing someone you love is never just matching eyes and a nose like a passport scanner; your brain has to pair the picture with a fast emotional warmth signal, or the most familiar face on earth feels like a stranger.
